item.title: [+1] 10-year G-Sec yield falls nearly 10 basis points to about 7.32% as crude slides
item.description:
Down 17 bps from the 7.48% four-year high on 26 October; short covering added. Traders see 7.25% if oil keeps falling. Extending last week's easing.

Real estate: mild tailwind (+1) — Cheaper funding

Why it matters: Lower yields cut borrowing costs, lift bank bond portfolios and ease the government's financing burden.

Market gauges: Bond market (G-Secs) +2, Fiscal & trade balance +1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks
